text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with<n>Biwa Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Those are so cute. I remember how<n>much I used to
love plushies.

She's looking at a claw machine filled<n>with little
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian and I used to have matching<n>plushies when
we were young.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to even imagine her playing<n>with one
now...

Her wistful expression as she gazes<n>at the
plushies gives me an idea.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A plushie at my age? Hmm. That's<n>an interesting
proposal.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It might be good to get back in touch<n>with my inner
child. But first, let's see<n>if you can get one at all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You sound pretty confident! Show me<n>your best,
then, Trainer!
There's no way I can fail now!
